title: Meta signs Oracle cloud deal, reported at about $20B

sources.quote: “Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) increased by $68 billion in Q2—up 15% sequentially to $523 billion—highlighted by new commitments from Meta, NVIDIA, and others,” said Oracle Principal Financial Officer, Doug Kehring.
Oracle would provide Meta with computing capacity for training and deploying AI models, in addition to Meta's existing cloud computing providers, the person said.

explain: Meta is renting AI computing from Oracle. Oracle confirmed a new Meta commitment in its December 2025 earnings release but gave no amount; in September 2025 Reuters and Bloomberg reported the two were negotiating a deal of about $20 billion, so the figure is an estimate.
